keywords: The Petitioners sought to quash the Wharf Clerk\'s order imposing mitigated forfeiture after Customs inquiry found that the Petitioners have declared their imports under a false HS Code and under-valued the price paid for biscuit wrappers imported; claimed Respondents\' acts under Section 47 of the Customs Ordinance was ultra vires and reasons for order were not provided. Held - Application dismissed without costs.
